fee_notes: The standard Initial Franchise Fee for a single Protected Territory is $59,500, due and payable upon signing the Franchise Agreement, fully earned upon receipt, and non-refundable. A 10% veteran discount is available for honorably discharged veterans of the U.S. armed forces and/or their spouses, reducing the fee to $53,550 for the first Protected Territory. Additionally, franchisees must purchase initial product inventory and certain equipment from Supportworks in the amount of $40,000 to $50,000 (non-refundable), plus applicable shipping and handling fees.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for a single Protected Territory is $59,500. The Initial Franchise Fee is due and payable when you sign the Franchise Agreement, is fully earned by us upon receipt, and is non-refundable. ... We offer a Veteran discount to honorably discharged veterans of the United States armed forces and their spouses. We will reduce the Initial Franchise Fee for your first Protected Territory by 10% for veterans and/or their spouses who have received an honorable discharge from the military and meet our qualifications for a Hello Garage Franchised Business.
